fusions.name: Pinning Cast
fusions.desc: A hard hurled blow that deals 34 damage, rising to 2 times that at maximum range. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Reaching Jab
fusions.desc: A long jab that deals 5 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Doorway Stand
fusions.desc: Pulls up to 4 enemies within 6 tiles onto you for 8 seconds, and they strike 50% harder while held.

fusions.name: Aimed True
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, a bolt leaps to the nearest enemy within 8 tiles, dealing 8 damage. Once every 4 seconds.
